source.text: Received. I will carefully study the financial and asset management sections. Thank you for your hard work!

source.text: Good morning everyone. Today, we officially launch the "Carbon Emission Accounting and Asset Management Platform" project. source.text: Received, @Mingzhi Li, we've noted this issue. I'm contacting the technical support of those data providers to get a clear call frequency limit this morning. You can first estimate based on a more conservative value (e.g., 10 QPS), and we'll adjust once we get the exact information.

source.speaker: Weihua Zhang
source.text: Well done, @Yaying Han, this is the task linkage I mentioned yesterday. Also, how is the competitive analysis progressing? @Guohua Han @Huilan Chen @Zhiyu Peng, any new findings? We need to speed up; we need a preliminary report by the end of this week.

source.speaker: Mingzhi Li
source.text: The technical side has confirmed there are no objections.

source.speaker: Yu Su
source.text: Received, Boss Zhang. I suggest that our first step should be to clearly identify 3-5 core competitors to benchmark against, to avoid a scope that's too broad and leads to superficial analysis. This way, we can concentrate our efforts.

source.speaker: Weihua Zhang
source.text: Good morning, everyone. With the project charter and stakeholders clarified, today we officially kick off the next critical task: developing the Value Proposition Canvas for this project. This will help us precisely align product features with customer needs.

source.speaker: Weihua Zhang
source.text: This morning's core team kick-off meeting was a great success. Thank you all for your thorough preparation and active participation. We effectively broke down the WBS for the initial phase of the project, and the responsibilities and immediate tasks for each line are now clearer. source.text: I've seen it! That transparent OLED TV really has a high-tech feel, but the news also complained that current TVs are full of unnecessary gimmicks and bloatware.

source.text: Okay, thank you all for your support. Based on our consensus, I will draft a formal proposal regarding the use of Jira and Confluence as our project management tools. source.speaker: Weihua Zhang
source.text: I announce that the Value Proposition Canvas development for this project is officially complete today. source.speaker: Weihua Zhang
source.text: @All members Good morning. Just a reminder, we will be holding a special meeting at 2 PM this afternoon to review and finalize the OKRs for the first phase of the project. source.text: Thank you all for your hard work today. The project charter and scope are much clearer now. All teams have followed up promptly. Please continue to push forward according to today's meeting conclusions to ensure we can finalize it next week. Have a great weekend!

source.text: Excellent, everyone, let's split up and get to work. I suggest we hold a workshop on Wednesday morning to consolidate our individual inputs onto a canvas for discussion. @Xuexin Yin, please help coordinate the time and initiate the meeting.

source.text: Whether it's Palantir's stock price or NVIDIA's new graphics cards, the core still lies in how much actual business value AI can truly create. We still need to prioritize getting the current projects off the ground. ☕

source.text: Received, Boss Huang. The plan is clear, and our team will follow it. The API alignment meeting was very productive, and risks have been brought under control.

My initial thought is that we need to identify the core leaders for the four directions: technology, product, operations, and finance.

source.text: I'm really looking forward to this project! The operations side is particularly interested in the "energy saving diagnosis" part. source.text: Moreover, this impact has already directly fed back into the financial market. Trump just launched the $TRUMP token, and its market cap soared to 73 billion in two days, only to be halved shortly after.

source.text: Thanks to Boss Lizhen Zhou for the reminder. This is very important, and I will specifically mark key financial-related nodes in the online plan. source.text: Are you referring to the one about 'AI training data running out'? It seems like Old Ma actually reached a consensus with many experts this time. It feels like the internet is almost scraped bare now 🙊

source.speaker: Huilan Chen
source.text: Great! Our design team can start building user story walls and design draft pages on Confluence. @Yang Zhao @Luhao Zhao, you can organize and upload the materials you have.

source.text: @All members Hello everyone, I'm Product Manager Peng Hou. With the project team and plan now clear, we need to decide on a unified project management and collaboration tool.
